protocol.generator: 200 deterministic pseudorandom labeled Prüfer words per order n=8..16 using Python random.Random(993041), plus four stated shape-biased words per order: constant 0, constant floor(n/2), alternating 0/1, and paired residues modulo max(2,floor(n/3))
protocol.exact_scope: sampled labeled tree encodings; duplicate unlabeled isomorphism classes retained; not exhaustive
protocol.selector: original degree-one vertices v with Delta_p(T-v)<0
protocol.zero_extension: vectors are explicitly padded with zeros beyond order n; first descent scanned through j=n
